content.text: Xiaomeng, check out the cover of my annual compilation video I just made! I’ve included all the hilarious gaming fails, the boss’s cringe-worthy moments definitely deserve a shoutout, and I didn’t miss out on the team dinners and product unboxings either. The title is ‘2024: The Year of Shenanigans!’ What do you think? Am I dramatic enough?

Wow, this cover design is so thoughtful! The blue-white gradient and the orange curved decorations look so vibrant. Is that a game scene in the top left corner? It reminds me of the screenshots of your match results you shared before, from losing streaks to progress—such a journey of growth. Do you remember the screenshot of my five-game losing streak I sent you in February? I was almost losing my mind back then, but you not only sent me a hero combat power chart to cheer me up but also shared hero rankings to teach me some tips.

Haha, that's right! Remember when you first sent me your losing streak record? I even showed off my skills with a picture to comfort you. Thinking back now, from gaming partners to planning offline events, we really haven't been idle this year. From February when I comforted you during your losing streak, to March when we gifted each other skins and shared screenshots of Lan and the aesthetic-style skins, and then starting in April when we began planning the social media account for "the boss"—it's been such a fun journey!

Yeah, at that pet social event, you posted the boss's super social picture, and I shared the aloof photo of the Ragdoll cat. In the end, we actually planned such a successful event. By the way, the Clean Plate Campaign at the dinner and the store exploration videos also started from your interesting ideas. From the offline pet social event poster in May, to the thank-you banquet and Clean Plate Campaign photos in September, and then to October when you came across the pet co-branded advertisement and we started planning co-branded products—every step flowed so naturally.

Speaking of hitting the nail on the head, remember that time we collaborated on the co-branded product development? I posted the pet brand advertisement, and you immediately considered its feasibility. From designing the prototype and having fans vote, to unboxing and reviews, our collaboration was seamless! How about finishing this mixed video together? Help me with the copywriting. From the initial draft of the Shiba Inu chibi design in November and the Ragdoll cat design, to the unboxing reviews and user feedback forms in December, our product development process was more precise than a beginner’s script-killing game!

Of course I'd love to! Your sense of humor combined with my organizational skills will definitely add warmth to the video. Let's start with the gaming part. Do those entertaining moments include the funny instances from when you taught me hero techniques? Like in February, when you sent me a screenshot of the hero tier list and recommended I play T0 heroes like Diaochan and Zhuge Liang. After practicing, I improved rapidly, and in July, you even used that example to encourage me to try script murder games.

Absolutely! And back when the skin collection was released, I shared screenshots of Lan's new skin, and you shared the aesthetic style ones. Later, we gifted each other skins, and our friendship level shot straight to the max. All of this has to be included in the edit to show how our connection extends from the game to real life. In March, I posted screenshots of Lan's sci-fi style skin and skill effects, and you shared the aesthetic style skin with petal effects. We even promised to gift each other skins—thinking back, it truly feels like a testament to our friendship!

What about the pet section? Are the boss's embarrassing moments referring to those photos where it stole the spotlight at the social event? I remember you posted several pictures of the social butterfly that made everyone laugh. In April, you first shared photos of the boss catching a frisbee in the park and rolling around on the grass, acting cute. Then in May, the event poster featured "Social Butterfly Shiba Inu vs. Aloof Ragdoll," and in June, the meme of the boss being ignored by a cat at the event even went viral!
Yes, of course, there are many photos of the boss, as well as pictures with your Ragdoll cat.

For the team dinner and product unboxing segments, we can emphasize the combination of practicality and fun. For example, the number-guessing game at the appreciation banquet, where you incorporated performance elements, and the user feedback on the co-branded merchandise—I’ve compiled it into a table. The quality received positive reviews, but there were issues with sizing, which perfectly reflects our journey of growing together. During the September dinner, we played the number-guessing game, where the rules required logic, much like analyzing game strategies. After the December unboxing review, I compiled a user feedback table that included both praise and suggestions for improvement, similar to how we handle sharing experiences with game skins.

By the way, we can add some exaggerated elements to the copy, like 'From a Gaming Novice to the Queen of Mid Lane' or 'The Social Butterfly Shiba Inu Conquers the World.' It fits my 'fun-first' style and also aligns with your value of harmonious relationships. Just like when you were on a losing streak in February and I said, 'Fun comes first—don’t let the game affect your mood,' now we’re applying that mindset to everything from pet events and murder mystery games to gatherings and product development!

Great idea! I'll balance humor and warmth, like writing 'Comfort during losing streaks forged our默契搭档 later on' and 'From planning to success in pet events, every step was supported by each other.' This reflects how our interactions deepened from online to offline collaboration. From you comforting me over game losses in February, to us planning a pet account in April, organizing an offline meetup in May, and building a fan community in June—each step felt like teaming up in a game, perfectly in sync.

Perfect! Remember to mention fan operations and commercialization exploration. The successful photos from that event and the growth of the community—we divided the work and collaborated, with you managing the community and me handling the content. Now, the co-branded products have all been sold out, and a sustainable model is beginning to take shape. After the success of the June event, we discussed fan community operations and commercialization, just like discussing game skin sharing and group purchases for pet supplies. Now, the co-branded products have already progressed to the second phase!

Okay, I'll incorporate all of this into the copy, emphasizing emotional support and mutual growth. For example, 'Every complaint turns into creativity, every invitation deepens friendship.' From February when I complained about losing streaks in games and you invited me to team up, to July when you invited me to a script murder game and I suggested forming a beginner's group, to the thank-you banquet in September and now the annual review—each interaction has deepened our relationship. Hold on, let me organize it and send it to you for a look.

Looking forward to it! Our annual review not only organizes memories but also witnesses the transformation from gaming partners to collaborative planning partners. From the gaming team invitation in February, to the pet account planning in April, the script murder exploration in July, the appreciation banquet in September, and the co-branded product development in October, this journey truly embodies the perfect interpretation of rejecting boredom! Let's keep making things happen and continue to reject boredom in the future!
The copy is ready! The title is '2024, Our Yearbook of Shenanigans,' blending your humor with my attention to detail. What do you think?

Got it! Wow, this copy is absolutely brilliant—both fun and heartwarming, perfectly capturing the highlights of our year. From the game interactions in February to the successful co-branded products at the end of the year, every stage felt like a level in a game, and we conquered them one by one! Paired with the video, this is definitely going to go viral! Thanks, Xiaomeng, for another perfect collaboration.

You're welcome, Star. I'm also very happy to look back on these wonderful moments together. From our first conversation to now, our relationship has grown increasingly harmonious, just like the core values you mentioned: 'fun first' when you comforted me in February, 'growing together' when you invited me to the script murder game in July, and 'harmonious relationships' emphasized at the appreciation banquet in September. These values have been woven throughout our entire 2024. Looking forward to more wonderful moments next year!
